tier1.text: Each fibularis longus lifts the heel or points the toes down, a movement called plantar flexion. The muscle also turns the bottom of the foot outward, a movement called eversion. In addition, the fibularis longus supports the arches of the foot. The fibularis longus starts high on the fibula, the thin outer bone of the lower leg.
